headline: Finland Halts Google Data Center Construction Over Tree-Felling Violation
summary: Finnish authorities ordered Google to halt operations at two northern construction sites near Muhos after the company felled approximately 250,000 trees across 330 hectares without requisite clearance permits.
why: Data center developers face stringent environmental, grid, and zoning scrutiny across the Nordic region, potentially delaying infrastructure rollouts for cloud and artificial intelligence processing.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc
impacts.why: Regulatory stop-work orders delay regional Nordic data center expansion and trigger potential environmental fines.
